structured.answer: I'm not opening an account with Psagot Trade for now. There's no deposit there, only shares and funds, and their advertising contradicts their own price list ('המסמך אומר אחרת'), so I'll ask my son or the bank. I did see that it costs 0.07% per purchase or sale with a 2 ₪ minimum, 0.03% a quarter, no monthly account fee, and a 10,000 ₪ minimum to open.
